models.method: The retailer response is solved first and inserted into the supplier's wholesale/mixing problem; regime comparisons identify the preferred administrator and capacity effects.

sources.quote: In the RA case, when the supplier has excess capacity of high-quality pro­ ducts and sells high- and low-quality products to consu­ mers through a retailer, at optimum, the retailer assembles and offers probabilistic products along with high-quality products ({h,p}) for a relatively low transaction cost or with both high- and low-quality products ({h,p,l}) for a rel­ atively high transaction cost (see Figure 5 and Table 1).
